dialogues.jp:
土曜日の商店街は、半ドンの帰りの学生で｛にぎ／賑｝わっ
ていた。
dialogues.en:
After school on Saturday afternoon, the shopping mall
bustles with students.
dialogues.text:
After school on Saturday afternoon, the shopping mall
bustles with students.

dialogues.jp:
そんな中を、いらただしげに歩きながら、俺は
携帯電話の番号を叩いていた。
dialogues.en: Walking around nervously, I tap numbers into my cell phone.
dialogues.text: Walking around nervously, I tap numbers into my cell phone.

dialogues.jp: 「さくらッ！」
dialogues.en: "Sakura!"
dialogues.text: "Sakura!"

dialogues.jp:
何度かけなおしても、さくらの家の電話がとら
れる気配はない。
dialogues.en:
I can't get through to Sakura no matter how many times I
call her house.
dialogues.text:
I can't get through to Sakura no matter how many times I
call her house.

dialogues.jp:
あいつが携帯さえ持っていれば、すぐにつかま
えられただろうに……。
dialogues.en:
I wish she had a cell phone, then I could've got through to
her easily.
dialogues.text:
I wish she had a cell phone, then I could've got through to
her easily.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ……」
dialogues.en: "Damn it..."
dialogues.text: "Damn it..."

dialogues.jp: 番号を変えて再び耳に当てる。
dialogues.en: I try a different number.
dialogues.text: I try a different number.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『はい白河です』
dialogues.en: 'Hello, it's Shirakawa.'
dialogues.text: 'Hello, it's Shirakawa.'

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり！」
dialogues.en: "Kotori!"
dialogues.text: "Kotori!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ、朝倉君だ。どうしたのそんなに慌てて？』
dialogues.en: 'Oh, Asakura-kun. You sound so upset. What's up?'
dialogues.text: 'Oh, Asakura-kun. You sound so upset. What's up?'

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「今、さくらのいる場所わかるか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know where Sakura is now?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know where Sakura is now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『ん？　さくら？』
dialogues.en: 'Hm? Sakura?'
dialogues.text: 'Hm? Sakura?'

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「芳乃講師だよ」
dialogues.en: "Yoshino-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Yoshino-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『……ごめん、誰のこと？』
dialogues.en: 'Sorry, but who are you talking about?'
dialogues.text: 'Sorry, but who are you talking about?'

dialogues.jp:
足が、地面から生えてきた手につかまれたよう
に動きを止めた。
dialogues.en: I freeze as if somebody grabbed my feet.
dialogues.text: I freeze as if somebody grabbed my feet.

dialogues.jp: からかって――からかっているか？
dialogues.en: Is it a joke?
dialogues.text: Is it a joke?

dialogues.jp:
寝ぼけているのか、こちらの声がちゃんと届い
ていないのか。
dialogues.en: Is she half asleep? Maybe she can't hear me?
dialogues.text: Is she half asleep? Maybe she can't hear me?

dialogues.jp: ……そう思いたい。
dialogues.en: I hope that's it.
dialogues.text: I hope that's it.

dialogues.jp: 「ごめん。後でかけなおす」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, but I'll call you later."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, but I'll call you later."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 『あ……うん、分かった』
dialogues.en: 'Oh, no problem.'
dialogues.text: 'Oh, no problem.'

dialogues.jp:
説明する時間が惜しくて、中途半端なところで
電話を切る。
dialogues.en: I hang up, not wanting to waste time explaining to her.
dialogues.text: I hang up, not wanting to waste time explaining to her.

dialogues.jp: さくら。
dialogues.en: Sakura.
dialogues.text: Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 現実の笑顔と、夢の冷たい瞳。
dialogues.en: Her smile in real life, and her cold eyes in the dream.
dialogues.text: Her smile in real life, and her cold eyes in the dream.

dialogues.jp: 成長していない外見と、成長した心。
dialogues.en: Her immature appearance and her mature mind.
dialogues.text: Her immature appearance and her mature mind.

dialogues.jp: 枯れない桜。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossom that never ends.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossom that never ends.

dialogues.jp: 不思議な夢。
dialogues.en: A strange dream.
dialogues.text: A strange dream.

dialogues.jp: 魔法使い。
dialogues.en: A witch.
dialogues.text: A witch.

dialogues.jp: 全ての出来事があいつを中心に動いている。
dialogues.en: Everything revolves around her.
dialogues.text: Everything revolves around her.

dialogues.jp: 「……まだ学園か」
dialogues.en: "Back to school..."
dialogues.text: "Back to school..."

dialogues.jp:
目の前に飛んできた桜の花びらを手で払い、俺
は学園に向かって……。
dialogues.en:
I walk to school, brushing away the cherry petals that fly
down in front of my eyes.
dialogues.text:
I walk to school, brushing away the cherry petals that fly
down in front of my eyes.

dialogues.jp: 「うん……歩こう」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, keep walking."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, keep walking."

dialogues.jp: 歩いた。
dialogues.en: And I did.
dialogues.text: And I did.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「さくら？　いないぞ」
dialogues.en: "Sakura? She isn't here."
dialogues.text: "Sakura? She isn't here."

dialogues.jp:
職員室から顔を出した暦先生は、軽く目を細め
て呟く。
dialogues.en:
Peering out of the staff room with her eyes narrowed,
Koyomi-sensei says so.
dialogues.text:
Peering out of the staff room with her eyes narrowed,
Koyomi-sensei says so.

dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……あぁ、そんな……」
dialogues.en: "Puff... aargh, oh no..."
dialogues.text: "Puff... aargh, oh no..."

dialogues.jp: 膝に手をついて全身でだれる。
dialogues.en: I flop, putting my hands onto the knees.
dialogues.text: I flop, putting my hands onto the knees.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なにハァハァ言ってるんだ朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you puffing so hard, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you puffing so hard, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、なんとなく、はぁ……途中から歩くの
　が面倒になりまして」
dialogues.en: "Well, I got tired of walking on the way here..."
dialogues.text: "Well, I got tired of walking on the way here..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「そうか。それは難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "Really, it's a bummer."
dialogues.text: "Really, it's a bummer."

dialogues.jp: タバコを揺らしながら。
dialogues.en: Lighting a cigarette.
dialogues.text: Lighting a cigarette.

dialogues.jp:
「どこか、行き先に、はぁ……心当たりありま
　せんか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you have any idea where Sakura is?"
dialogues.text: "Do you have any idea where Sakura is?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Hmmmm... No..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmmm... No..."

dialogues.jp:
反応が鈍く、暦先生はなにか眉をひそめて視線
をはずす。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei's reaction was slow, and she looked away,
knitting her oniichanws.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei's reaction was slow, and she looked away,
knitting her oniichanws.

dialogues.jp: 「なにか知ってるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you know anything about her?"
dialogues.text: "Do you know anything about her?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや……お前、何の話をしているんだ？」
dialogues.en: "No. What are you talking about?"
dialogues.text: "No. What are you talking about?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「うちの学園に、さくらなんて可愛らしい名前
　の講師はいないぞ？」
dialogues.en: "We don't have a teacher named Sakura."
dialogues.text: "We don't have a teacher named Sakura."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「誰と間違えているんだ？」
dialogues.en: "You may be thinking of somebody else."
dialogues.text: "You may be thinking of somebody else."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なに言ってるんですか？　あんな特徴的なや
　つ、忘れようったって無理でしょうが？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean? She's unique - nobody can mistake her!"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean? She's unique - nobody can mistake her!"

dialogues.jp: ことりと音夢との会話が甦る。
dialogues.en: I remember my conversations with Kotori and Nemu.
dialogues.text: I remember my conversations with Kotori and Nemu.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉の知り合いではあるんだな」
dialogues.en: "You know her well, right?"
dialogues.text: "You know her well, right?"

dialogues.jp: まただ。
dialogues.en: Here I go again.
dialogues.text: Here I go again.

dialogues.jp: また、ここでも記憶が抜けている。
dialogues.en: My memory is missing in this part.
dialogues.text: My memory is missing in this part.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ、どこに行ったんだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Damn it! Where did it go?"
dialogues.text: "Damn it! Where did it go?"

dialogues.jp: 小さく叫ぶ。
dialogues.en: I exclaim under my breath.
dialogues.text: I exclaim under my breath.

dialogues.jp: 「本当に、覚えてないんですか！？」
dialogues.en: "Are you sure you don't remember her?"
dialogues.text: "Are you sure you don't remember her?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「日本語が正しくない。覚えてないじゃなくて、
　知らない――だ」
dialogues.en:
"Your Japanese was wrong. You should say I don't know her
instead of I don't remember her."
dialogues.text:
"Your Japanese was wrong. You should say I don't know her
instead of I don't remember her."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「なぁ、お前はさくらって子のことを知ってる
　んだろ？　いつも会う場所とかないのか？」
dialogues.en:
"Hey, you know this kid Sakura, don't you? Then, do you
remember the places you used to meet her?"
dialogues.text:
"Hey, you know this kid Sakura, don't you? Then, do you
remember the places you used to meet her?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「さくらといつも会っている場所……俺の部
　屋？」
dialogues.en: "The place we always meet is... my room!?"
dialogues.text: "The place we always meet is... my room!?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、学生の身分でしけこんでるのか」
dialogues.en: "Whoa, you're doing well for a student."
dialogues.text: "Whoa, you're doing well for a student."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「うわ、そこっ！　職員室前の廊下で変なこと
　呟かないように！」
dialogues.en: "Hey, there! Don't say that in front of the staff room!"
dialogues.text: "Hey, there! Don't say that in front of the staff room!"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「冗談だよ。他にはないのか」
dialogues.en: "I'm just kidding. Where else did you meet with her?"
dialogues.text: "I'm just kidding. Where else did you meet with her?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いや、いつも支離滅裂に出てくるから……」
dialogues.en: "Well, actually I met her at many places."
dialogues.text: "Well, actually I met her at many places."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「夢の中で会った子じゃないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Is she the girl you met in the dream?"
dialogues.text: "Is she the girl you met in the dream?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Yeah..."
dialogues.text: "Yeah..."

dialogues.jp: 暦先生の何気ない一言に顔を見つめる。
dialogues.en: I gaze at her as she casually suggests this.
dialogues.text: I gaze at her as she casually suggests this.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、夢の中で出会ったんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en: I know I met her in the dream, for sure.
dialogues.text: I know I met her in the dream, for sure.

dialogues.jp:
だったら――あの場所でなら、会えるかも知れ
ない。
dialogues.en: If it's true, I may be able to see her there again.
dialogues.text: If it's true, I may be able to see her there again.

dialogues.jp: 「俺……帰ります」
dialogues.en: "I've gotta get going."
dialogues.text: "I've gotta get going."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「おい朝倉！　どこに行く気だ！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Asakura! Where do you think you are going?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Asakura! Where do you think you are going?"

dialogues.jp:
なにか危ないモノでもやってるとでも思われた
か。
dialogues.en: She might be thinking I will do something dangerous.
dialogues.text: She might be thinking I will do something dangerous.

dialogues.jp:
俺は面白くて、くすくす、と腹を抱えて首を振
る。
dialogues.en: I shake my head, chuckle and hold my stomach.
dialogues.text: I shake my head, chuckle and hold my stomach.

dialogues.jp: 「いえ、俺にしか行けないところなんです」
dialogues.en: "Well, somewhere that only I can go."
dialogues.text: "Well, somewhere that only I can go."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「どこだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where's that?"
dialogues.text: "Where's that?"

dialogues.jp:
暦先生の問いかけに、俺はにっこりと笑いかけ
る。
dialogues.en: I give a big grin when Koyomi-sensei asks.
dialogues.text: I give a big grin when Koyomi-sensei asks.

dialogues.jp: 「夢の中ですよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm going into my dream."
dialogues.text: "I'm going into my dream."

dialogues.jp: ◆失われた記憶２◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lost memories 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lost memories 2◆

dialogues.jp:
全ての原因はさくらにある。そんなことと、純
粋な気持ちでさくらに会いたかったが、暫く前
からさくらは姿を消していた。
dialogues.en:
I knew this was all Sakura's fault, and yet I wanted to see
her dearly, but she'd disappeared a while ago.
dialogues.text:
I knew this was all Sakura's fault, and yet I wanted to see
her dearly, but she'd disappeared a while ago.

dialogues.jp:
俺の前からも、他の全ての人の記憶からもさく
らは姿を消していた――。
dialogues.en:
Sakura was gone not only from me, but also from everybody's
memory.
dialogues.text:
Sakura was gone not only from me, but also from everybody's
memory.

dialogues.jp:
どうしても見つけられなかったが、暦先生との
会話をヒントに、俺は夢のなかでアイツに会う
ことを思いついた。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't find her, but a conversation with Koyomi-sensei
gave me a hint that I might be able to see Sakura in my
dream.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't find her, but a conversation with Koyomi-sensei
gave me a hint that I might be able to see Sakura in my
dream.
